description: Open interest of one coin on every venue over time (hourly or daily buckets) with the total per bucket, and the current open interest and share of each venue. Use it for "on which exchange is BTC open interest growing?". Binance and Bybit reach back with each exchange’s open-interest history (in USDT).

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Number of buckets, newest first (default 24 for 1h, 30 for 1d). Capped by the plan history (no key 24 h, a free key 30 days); the answer says when it was cut.

name: get_open_interest_by_exchange

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

now.description: totalUsd, updatedAt and byVenue (openInterestUsd, share, updatedAt) right now.

points.description: Newest buckets: t, totalUsd, byVenue (openInterestUsd, unit), closed.

title: Open interest by exchange
